title: APP rank-decile calibration profile
hypothesis: If the APP full ranking contains useful ordinal information beyond its mean-rank summary, actual winning numbers should be concentrated non-uniformly across ten equal-sized rank deciles, with a top-heavy monotone profile.

definitions.deciles: Ten consecutive rank bins of four ranks each: D1=1-4, D2=5-8, ..., D10=37-40.
definitions.target_vector: For each strict-prior forecast, count how many of the five drawn numbers have ranks in each decile.
definitions.null: Conditional on each forecast ranking, the five winning ranks are a uniformly sampled 5-subset of ranks 1..40; per target each decile has expected 0.5 hits.
definitions.omnibus: Pearson statistic sum_b (O_b - 0.5*N)^2/(0.5*N) over ten deciles.
definitions.trend: S=sum_b (11-b)*O_b, where larger values indicate concentration toward better (smaller-numbered) deciles; null expectation is 27.5*N.

method.split_rule: Use parent Q123 chronological split unchanged.
method.strict_prior: Inherited only from the pinned, independently validated Q123 ledger: each row's scorer was run on archive prefix [0,t), before the target draw.

conditional_randomization.method: For each replicate and each blind target, sample five distinct ranks uniformly without replacement from 1..40; aggregate decile counts and compute omnibus and trend statistics.

bootstrap.method: Circular moving-block bootstrap over chronological blind target vectors; percentile 95% intervals for each decile's mean hits and trend score.

method.multiplicity: Holm correction across the two preregistered blind-OOS endpoints (omnibus and top-heavy trend). Decile-specific intervals are descriptive pointwise intervals; no individual decile significance claims. No correction claim for the full Q00-Q125 research family.

guardrails: No production scorer or forecast freeze is changed.
This is a diagnostic decomposition of Q123 ordinal ranks, not an independent virgin holdout.
Historical Blind OOS remains exposed to previous SONAR research.
No retuning on Validation or Blind OOS.
No automatic merge or engine promotion; PRs #6, #7 and #8 remain untouched.
next_action: After official publication of contest 315, append outcomes only to existing immutable Q123/Q124 freezes and the paired Q60 ledger; do not reconstruct any freeze.
